newsitem.title: GREECE: XIOSBANK MUTUAL FUND ASSETS HIT 100BLN DRS END-FEB.
newsitem.headline: XIOSBANK MUTUAL FUND ASSETS HIT 100BLN DRS END-FEB.

text.p: Assets under management of Greece's Xiosbank stood at 105.36 billion drachmas at the end of February compared to 77.1 billion at the end of 1996, an increase of 37 percent, the bank said in a statement.

Xios fixed income fund saw its assets rise to 40.8 billion drachmas and returned 2.16 percent in the first two months of the year. Xios invest saw its assets rise to 8.18 billion drachmas and returned 6.92 percent, ranked first among funds of its class, it said.

Xioscapital had assets of 49.34 billion drachmas at the end of February and returned 1.75 percent while Xios growth had assets under management of 3.03 billion drachmas and returned 33.52 percent in the first two months of the year. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
